main_text.p: continuo spiritu trahitur in longum, nunc variatur inflexo, nunc diftingnitur concifo, copulatur intorto, promittitur reuocato, infcatur exinopinato : interdum & fecum ipfe murmurat, plenus, grauis, acutus, creber, extentus, vbi vifum eft, vibrans, fummus, medius, imus: breuiterque omnia in paruulis tam faucibus, quae tot exquifitis tibiarum tormentis ars hominum excogitauit, vt non fit dubium hanc fuauitatem praemonftratam efficaci aufpicio cum in ore Stefichori ceci- nit infantis.

Ac ne quis dubitet artis effe, plures fingu- lis funt cantus, neciidem omnibus, fed fui cuique. Certant inter fe, palamque animo- fa contentio eft. Victa, morte fz,e vitam fi- nit, fpiritu prius deficiente quam cantu. Me- ditantur aliae iuniores, verfusque quos imi- tentur, accipiunt. Audit difcipula intensione magna, & reddit vicibus cantum. In- telligitur emendatae correctio, & in docente quaedam reprehenfio. Ergo feruorum illis pretia funt, & quidem ampliora, quam qui- busarmigeri olim parabantur. Scio candidam feftertiis fex (hoc eft, 1ṡo.coronatis) alii- oquin, quod eft propeinufitatum, veniiffe, quae Agrippinae Claudii Caesaris coniugido- no daretur &c. Hactenus Plinius. Idem cap. 42. Caesares iuuenes habuiffe lufcinias, ftur- nosque graeco & latino femone dociles, prae- tereaq;

page.notes: Transcription is my best reading of the scan. Doubtful words: "paruulis" (the scan reads "paruu-" then "lis" on the next line, so it is hyphenated across the line end; I kept the printed form "paruu-lis" as intended). "1ṡo.coronatis" is a doubtful rendering of "Io. coronatis"/"150. coronatis" and is marked for checking. The running head "De Vita" is not clearly legible on the scan and may be wrong; the page number 386 is read from the head. Section and catchword: "tereaq;" at the foot is a catchword, but it is partly cut off on the scan.
